offering_description.value: Balchem formulates and manufactures nutritional and functional ingredients for food, beverage, and dietary supplement makers, along with feed additives for animal nutrition companies. It also supplies packaged gases for medical device sterilization and food fumigation, and makes chelated micronutrients for crop nutrition.

primary_products.value: Choline and chelated minerals for human nutrition; encapsulated food ingredients and powder blends; animal feed additives; sterilization and fumigation gases; chelated crop micronutrients

customer_segment.value: B2B: Food, beverage, supplement, and feed manufacturers, livestock producers, medical device sterilizers, food processors, and crop input suppliers

end_markets.value: Food and beverages; dietary supplements; animal nutrition; medical device sterilization; crop nutrition

revenue_model.value: product sales: Bulk nutritional and functional ingredients, feed additives, packaged gases, and crop micronutrients

value_chain_position.value: OEM / manufacturer: Processes nutrient compounds, food ingredients, and industrial chemicals into specialty products for manufacturers, sterilizers, and agricultural suppliers

geography_served.value: global: North America, Europe, Asia, and other international markets

specialization.value: diversified: Human nutrition and food ingredients, animal feed additives, sterilization and fumigation gases, and crop micronutrients

distribution_channels.value: direct sales: Sales teams serving manufacturers, feed companies, and industrial sterilization customers; distributors / dealers: Specialty distributors for ingredients and agricultural inputs

regulatory_exposure.value: high: EPA registration for sterilant and fumigant uses, plus FDA food, dietary supplement, and animal feed requirements
